title: Notify the patient by WhatsApp from an alert
summary: Send the rule's WhatsApp template to the alert's patient.

steps.title: Menu → Alerts Center
steps.details: What the system detected with the alert rules and the team needs to work on.

steps.title: Choose the alert
steps.details: The message goes out with the rule's template and the alert's details (patient, date, amount…).

steps.title: Send WhatsApp
steps.details: Sent as soon as you tap it. Disabled if the patient has no phone or the rule has no WhatsApp template. It stays in the alert's history.
